Welcome to an exclusive collection of three bespoke villas that redefine contemporary luxury while embracing Bali's rich cultural heritage. Designed by award-winning architect Gaurang Khemka and crafted by Studio Anso's Aswin Soengkono, this villa seamlessly integrates modernity with nature. Inspired by Balinese traditions, the villa's 7-meter-high ceilings, open-plan living spaces, and full-height glass doors create a harmonious connection with the lush surroundings.

Built alongside Bali's traditional Subak irrigation system, you'll enjoy the peaceful sound of flowing river water, enhancing the natural ambiance of your private retreat.

• Convenience & Storage - The villa is designed with storage areas on both floors, ensuring effortless organization. A dedicated helper's room and bathroom add to the convenience of daily living.
• Outdoor Retreat - Relax in your private pool, alfresco dining area, and pool pavilion, all set against the backdrop of a bordering stream and tropical forest.

Sustainability & Smart Investment
This villa is built with eco-conscious materials, offering potable soft water throughout and recycled wastewater systems for landscaping. Investors can expect:
• Projected capital appreciation of over 25% annually for the next five years

Prime Location in the Heart of Canggu

Unmatched Quality Assurance

A New Era of Super Luxury at an Unbeatable Value

Whether as a dream home or a lucrative investment, this is your chance to own a slice of paradise in Bali's most sought-after location.
